3. **Vertically Stacked Mobile Workbench:**
   - **3D Viewport:** Front and center with touch-friendly 360° rotate hint, animation pose toggles (*Stand*, *Walk*, *Run*), and 44px *Classic (4px Steve)* / *Slim (3px Alex)* architecture switcher and layer checkboxes.
   - **64×64 UV Canvas:** Full-width container with horizontally scrollable body-part tabs (*Unwrapped UV*, *Head*, *Torso*, *Limbs*), grid toggles, and coordinate readouts.
   - **Toolbox Strip & Swatches:** Chunky touch-optimized icon strip with active states (*Pencil*, *Eraser*, *Eyedropper*, *Bucket*, *Mirror*, *Zoom*, *Undo*, *Redo*) paired with a 2-row color swatch palette and hex picker.

4. **Sticky Bottom Action Bar:**
   - Anchored at the screen bottom with high z-index: primary full-width Grass Green (`#3E8E2A`) **"Download Skin (.PNG)"** button alongside secondary quick actions (**Export .mcpack** and **Copy URL**).

5. **Quick Starters Horizontal Carousel & AI Card:**
   - Template cards formatted as a smooth horizontal swipe track displaying ~2.3 cards at a glance (*Knight*, *Anime Hero*, *Cute Bunny*, *Robot*, *Street Hoodie*, *Creeper Style*) with 44px edit buttons.
   - Full-width Diamond Teal AI generator card featuring input prompt, prompt suggestion chips, prompt-to-skin result row, and action CTA.

6. **Single-Column Capabilities Bento, Workflow, & Knowledge Base:**

   - Stacked 3-step crafting workflow and full-width FAQ accordion items.

7. **Mobile Footer & Spacing:**
